ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.label: access location in the background
ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.description: This app can access location at any time, even while the app is not in use.

ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION.label: access approximate location only in the foreground
ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION.description: This app can get your approximate location from location services while the app is in use. Location services for your device must be turned on for the app to get location.

ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.label: access precise location only in the foreground
ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.description: This app can get your precise location from location services while the app is in use. Location services for your device must be turned on for the app to get location. This may increase battery usage.

ACCESS_HIDDEN_PROFILES.label: Access hidden profiles
ACCESS_HIDDEN_PROFILES.description: Allows the app to access hidden profiles.

ACCESS_IMS_CALL_SERVICE.label: access IMS call service
ACCESS_IMS_CALL_SERVICE.description: Allows the app to use the IMS service to make calls without your intervention.

ACCESS_LAST_KNOWN_CELL_ID.label: Access last known cell identity.
ACCESS_LAST_KNOWN_CELL_ID.description: Allows an app to access to the last known cell identity provided by telephony.

ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.label: access local network devices
ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.description: Allows the app to access local network devices

ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS.label: access extra location provider commands
ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS.description: Allows the app to access extra location provider commands. This may allow the app to interfere with the operation of the GPS or other location sources.

ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.label: read locations from your media collection
ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION.description: Allows the app to read locations from your media collection.

ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.label: view network connections
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.description: Allows the app to view information about network connections such as which networks exist and are connected.

ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY.label: access Do Not Disturb
ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY.description: Allows the app to read and write Do Not Disturb configuration.

ACCESS_VIBRATOR_STATE.label: Allows the app to access the vibrator state.
ACCESS_VIBRATOR_STATE.description: Allows the app to access the vibrator state.

ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.label: view Wi-Fi connections
ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.description: Allows the app to view information about Wi-Fi networking, such as whether Wi-Fi is enabled and name of connected Wi-Fi devices.

ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.label: recognize physical activity
ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.description: This app can recognize your physical activity.

ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.label: answer phone calls
ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS.description: Allows the app to answer an incoming phone call.

BACKGROUND_CAMERA.label: take pictures and videos in the background
BACKGROUND_CAMERA.description: This app can take pictures and record videos using the camera at any time.

BIND_CARRIER_SERVICES.label: bind to carrier services
BIND_CARRIER_SERVICES.description: Allows the holder to bind to carrier services. Should never be needed for normal apps.

BIND_CELL_BROADCAST_SERVICE.label: Forward cell broadcast messages
BIND_CELL_BROADCAST_SERVICE.description: Allows the app to bind to the cell broadcast module in order to forward cell broadcast messages as they are received. Cell broadcast alerts are delivered in some locations to warn you of emergency situations. Malicious apps may interfere with the performance or operation of your device when an emergency cell broadcast is received.

BLUETOOTH.label: pair with Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH.description: Allows the app to view the configuration of the Bluetooth on the phone, and to make and accept connections with paired devices.

BLUETOOTH_ADMIN.label: access Bluetooth settings
BLUETOOTH_ADMIN.description: Allows the app to configure the local Bluetooth phone, and to discover and pair with remote devices.

BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE.label: advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE.description: Allows the app to advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices

BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.label: connect to paired Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.description: Allows the app to connect to paired Bluetooth devices

BLUETOOTH_SCAN.label: discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices
BLUETOOTH_SCAN.description: Allows the app to discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices

BODY_SENSORS.label: Access body sensor data, like heart rate, while in use
BODY_SENSORS.description: Allows the app to access body sensor data, such as heart rate, temperature, and blood oxygen percentage, while the app is in use.

BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND.label: Access body sensor data, like heart rate, while in the background
BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND.description: Allows the app to access body sensor data, such as heart rate, temperature, and blood oxygen percentage, while the app is in the background.

BROADCAST_STICKY.label: send sticky broadcast
BROADCAST_STICKY.description: Allows the app to send sticky broadcasts, which remain after the broadcast ends. Excessive use may make the phone slow or unstable by causing it to use too much memory.

CALL_COMPANION_APP.label: see and control calls through the system.
CALL_COMPANION_APP.description: Allows the app to see and control ongoing calls on the device. This includes information such as call numbers for calls and the state of the calls.

CALL_PHONE.label: directly call phone numbers
CALL_PHONE.description: Allows the app to call phone numbers without your intervention. This may result in unexpected charges or calls. Note that this doesn't allow the app to call emergency numbers. Malicious apps may cost you money by making calls without your confirmation, or dial carrier codes which cause incoming calls to be automatically forwarded to another number.

CAMERA.label: take pictures and videos
CAMERA.description: This app can take pictures and record videos using the camera while the app is in use.

CAMERA_HEADLESS_SYSTEM_USER.label: Allow an application or service to access camera as Headless System User.
CAMERA_HEADLESS_SYSTEM_USER.description: This app can access camera as Headless System User.

CAMERA_OPEN_CLOSE_LISTENER.label: Allow an application or service to receive callbacks about camera devices being opened or closed.
CAMERA_OPEN_CLOSE_LISTENER.description: This app can receive callbacks when any camera device is being opened (by what application) or closed.

CAPTURE_KEYBOARD.label: capture keys
CAPTURE_KEYBOARD.description: Allows the app to capture keys before system can process system shortcuts and actions.

CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE.label: change network connectivity
CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE.description: Allows the app to change the state of network connectivity.

CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE.label: allow Wi-Fi Multicast reception
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE.description: Allows the app to receive packets sent to all devices on a Wi-Fi network using multicast addresses, not just your phone. It uses more power than the non-multicast mode.

CHANGE_WIFI_STATE.label: connect and disconnect from Wi-Fi
CHANGE_WIFI_STATE.description: Allows the app to connect to and disconnect from Wi-Fi access points and to make changes to device configuration for Wi-Fi networks.

DELIVER_COMPANION_MESSAGES.label: Deliver companion messages
DELIVER_COMPANION_MESSAGES.description: Allows a companion app to deliver companion messages to other devices.

DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE.label: detect screen captures of app windows
DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE.description: This app will get notified when a screenshot is taken while the app is in use.

DISABLE_KEYGUARD.label: disable your screen lock
DISABLE_KEYGUARD.description: Allows the app to disable the keylock and any associated password security. For example, the phone disables the keylock when receiving an incoming phone call, then re-enables the keylock when the call is finished.

EXEMPT_FROM_AUDIO_RECORD_RESTRICTIONS.label: exempt from audio record restrictions
EXEMPT_FROM_AUDIO_RECORD_RESTRICTIONS.description: Exempt the app from restrictions to record audio.

EXPAND_STATUS_BAR.label: expand/collapse status bar
EXPAND_STATUS_BAR.description: Allows the app to expand or collapse the status bar.

FORCE_USE_LOOPBACK_INTERFACE.label: force use loopback interface
FORCE_USE_LOOPBACK_INTERFACE.description: Allows the app to interact with other apps over loopback interface without requiring the other app to hold loopback permissions

FOREGROUND_SERVICE.label: run foreground service
FOREGROUND_SERVICE.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services.

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA.label: run foreground service with the type "camera"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "camera"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE.label: run foreground service with the type "connectedDevice"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "connectedDevice"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC.label: run foreground service with the type "dataSync"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "dataSync"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_FILE_MANAGEMENT.label: run foreground service with the type "fileManagement"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_FILE_MANAGEMENT.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "fileManagement"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH.label: run foreground service with the type "health"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "health"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION.label: run foreground service with the type "location"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "location"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaPlayback"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaPlayback"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROCESSING.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaProcessing"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROCESSING.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaProcessing"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaProjection"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaProjection"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE.label: run foreground service with the type "microphone"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "microphone"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_PHONE_CALL.label: run foreground service with the type "phoneCall"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_PHONE_CALL.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "phoneCall"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING.label: run foreground service with the type "remoteMessaging"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "remoteMessaging"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE.label: run foreground service with the type "specialUse"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "specialUse"

FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED.label: run foreground service with the type "systemExempted"
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "systemExempted"

GET_ACCOUNTS.label: find accounts on the device
GET_ACCOUNTS.description: Allows the app to get the list of accounts known by the phone. This may include any accounts created by applications you have installed.

GET_PACKAGE_SIZE.label: measure app storage space
GET_PACKAGE_SIZE.description: Allows the app to retrieve its code, data, and cache sizes

GET_TASKS.label: retrieve running apps
GET_TASKS.description: Allows the app to retrieve information about currently and recently running tasks. This may allow the app to discover information about which applications are used on the device.

HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS.label: hide other apps overlays
HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS.description: This app can request that the system hides overlays originating from apps from being shown on top of it.

HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS.label: access sensor data at a high sampling rate
HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS.description: Allows the app to sample sensor data at a rate greater than 200 Hz

INTERNET.label: have full network access
INTERNET.description: Allows the app to create network sockets and use custom network protocols. The browser and other applications provide means to send data to the internet, so this permission is not required to send data to the internet.

KILL_ALL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES.label: close other apps
KILL_ALL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES.description: Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.

KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES.label: close other apps
KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES.description: Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.

MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS.label: Manage ongoing calls
MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS.description: Allows an app to see details about ongoing calls on your device and to control these calls.

MANAGE_OWN_CALLS.label: route calls through the system
MANAGE_OWN_CALLS.description: Allows the app to route its calls through the system in order to improve the calling experience.

MANAGE_PROFILE_AND_DEVICE_OWNERS.label: manage profile and device owners
MANAGE_PROFILE_AND_DEVICE_OWNERS.description: Allows apps to set the profile owners and the device owner.

MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS.label: change your audio settings
MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS.description: Allows the app to modify global audio settings such as volume and which speaker is used for output.

NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.label: interact with nearby Wi‑Fi devices
NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES.description: Allows the app to advertise, connect, and determine the relative position of nearby Wi‑Fi devices

NFC.label: control Near Field Communication
NFC.description: Allows the app to communicate with Near Field Communication (NFC) tags, cards, and readers.

NFC_PREFERRED_PAYMENT_INFO.label: Preferred NFC Payment Service Information
NFC_PREFERRED_PAYMENT_INFO.description: Allows the app to get preferred nfc payment service information like registered aids and route destination.

NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT.label: Secure Element transaction event
NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT.description: Allows the app to receive information about transactions happening on a Secure Element.

PERSISTENT_ACTIVITY.label: make app always run
PERSISTENT_ACTIVITY.description: Allows the app to make parts of itself persistent in memory. This can limit memory available to other apps slowing down the phone.

POST_NOTIFICATIONS.label: show notifications
POST_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Allows the app to show notifications

POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS.label: Show live updates
POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS.description: Allows the app to display ongoing, time-sensitive notifications on the status bar and lock screen

PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS.label: reroute outgoing calls
PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS.description: Allows the app to see the number being dialed during an outgoing call with the option to redirect the call to a different number or abort the call altogether.

QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.label: query all packages
QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.description: Allows an app to see all installed packages.

RANGING.label: determine relative position between nearby devices
RANGING.description: Allow the app to determine relative position between nearby devices

READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE.label: read basic telephony status and identity
READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE.description: Allows the app to access the basic telephony features of the device.

READ_CALENDAR.label: Read calendar events and details
READ_CALENDAR.description: This app can read all calendar events stored on your phone and share or save your calendar data.

READ_CALL_LOG.label: read call log
READ_CALL_LOG.description: This app can read your call history.

READ_CELL_BROADCASTS.label: read cell broadcast messages
READ_CELL_BROADCASTS.description: Allows the app to read cell broadcast messages received by your device. Cell broadcast alerts are delivered in some locations to warn you of emergency situations. Malicious apps may interfere with the performance or operation of your device when an emergency cell broadcast is received.

READ_CONTACTS.label: read your contacts
READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows the app to read data about your contacts stored on your phone. Apps will also have access to the accounts on your phone that have created contacts. This may include accounts created by apps you have installed. This permission allows apps to save your contact data, and malicious apps may share contact data without your knowledge.

READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.label: read the contents of your shared storage
READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows the app to read the contents of your shared storage.

READ_INSTALL_SESSIONS.label: read install sessions
READ_INSTALL_SESSIONS.description: Allows an application to read install sessions. This allows it to see details about active package installations.

READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.label: read audio files from shared storage
READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.description: Allows the app to read audio files from your shared storage.

READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.label: read image files from shared storage
READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.description: Allows the app to read image files from your shared storage.

READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.label: read video files from shared storage
READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.description: Allows the app to read video files from your shared storage.

READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED.label: read user selected image and video files from shared storage
READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED.description: Allows the app to read image and video files that you select from your shared storage.

READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.label: read phone numbers
READ_PHONE_NUMBERS.description: Allows the app to access the phone numbers of the device.

READ_PHONE_STATE.label: read phone status and identity
READ_PHONE_STATE.description: Allows the app to access the phone features of the device. This permission allows the app to determine the phone number and device IDs, whether a call is active, and the remote number connected by a call.

READ_SMS.label: read your text messages (SMS or MMS)
READ_SMS.description: This app can read all SMS (text) messages stored on your phone.

READ_SYNC_SETTINGS.label: read sync settings
READ_SYNC_SETTINGS.description: Allows the app to read the sync settings for an account. For example, this can determine whether the People app is synced with an account.

READ_SYNC_STATS.label: read sync statistics
READ_SYNC_STATS.description: Allows an app to read the sync stats for an account, including the history of sync events and how much data is synced.

RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED.label: run at startup
RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED.description: Allows the app to have itself started as soon as the system has finished booting. This can make it take longer to start the phone and allow the app to slow down the overall phone by always running.

RECEIVE_MMS.label: receive text messages (MMS)
RECEIVE_MMS.description: Allows the app to receive and process MMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.

RECEIVE_SMS.label: receive text messages (SMS)
RECEIVE_SMS.description: Allows the app to receive and process SMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.

RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH.label: receive text messages (WAP)
RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH.description: Allows the app to receive and process WAP messages. This permission includes the ability to monitor or delete messages sent to you without showing them to you.

RECORD_AUDIO.label: record audio
RECORD_AUDIO.description: This app can record audio using the microphone while the app is in use.

RECORD_BACKGROUND_AUDIO.label: record audio in the background
RECORD_BACKGROUND_AUDIO.description: This app can record audio using the microphone at any time.

REORDER_TASKS.label: reorder running apps
REORDER_TASKS.description: Allows the app to move tasks to the foreground and background. The app may do this without your input.

REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_WATCH.label: Companion Watch profile permission to manage watches
REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_WATCH.description: Allows a companion app to manage watches.

REQUEST_COMPANION_RUN_IN_BACKGROUND.label: run in the background
REQUEST_COMPANION_RUN_IN_BACKGROUND.description: This app can run in the background. This may drain battery faster.

REQUEST_COMPANION_START_FOREGROUND_SERVI.label: Start foreground services from background
REQUEST_COMPANION_START_FOREGROUND_SERVI.description: Allows a companion app to start foreground services from background.

REQUEST_COMPANION_USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND.label: use data in the background
REQUEST_COMPANION_USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND.description: This app can use data in the background. This may increase data usage.

REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES.label: request delete packages
REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES.description: Allows an application to request deletion of packages.

REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS.label: ask to ignore battery optimizations
REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS.description: Allows an app to ask for permission to ignore battery optimizations for that app.

REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.label: request install packages
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.description: Allows an application to request installation of packages.

REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENC.label: Observe companion device presence
REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENC.description: Allows a companion app to observe companion device presence when the devices are nearby or far-away.

REQUEST_PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY.label: request screen lock complexity
REQUEST_PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY.description: Allows the app to learn the screen lock complexity level (high, medium, low or none), which indicates the possible range of length and type of the screen lock. The app can also suggest to users that they update the screen lock to a certain level but users can freely ignore and navigate away. Note that the screen lock is not stored in plaintext so the app does not know the exact password.

RESTART_PACKAGES.label: close other apps
RESTART_PACKAGES.description: Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.

RUN_IN_BACKGROUND.label: run in the background
RUN_IN_BACKGROUND.description: This app can run in the background. This may drain battery faster.

SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.label: Schedule precisely timed actions
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.description: This app can schedule work to happen at a desired time in the future. This also means that the app can run when you’re not actively using the device.

SEND_SMS.label: send and view SMS messages
SEND_SMS.description: Allows the app to send SMS messages. This may result in unexpected charges. Malicious apps may cost you money by sending messages without your confirmation.

SET_TIME_ZONE.label: set time zone
SET_TIME_ZONE.description: Allows the app to change the phone's time zone.

SET_WALLPAPER.label: set wallpaper
SET_WALLPAPER.description: Allows the app to set the system wallpaper.

SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS.label: adjust your wallpaper size
SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS.description: Allows the app to set the system wallpaper size hints.

START_REVIEW_PERMISSION_DECISIONS.label: start view permission decisions
START_REVIEW_PERMISSION_DECISIONS.description: Allows the holder to start screen to review permission decisions. Should never be needed for normal apps.

START_VIEW_APP_FEATURES.label: start view app features
START_VIEW_APP_FEATURES.description: Allows the holder to start viewing the features info for an app.

START_VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE.label: start view permission usage
START_VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE.description: Allows the holder to start the permission usage for an app. Should never be needed for normal apps.

SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.label: This app can appear on top of other apps
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.description: This app can appear on top of other apps or other parts of the screen. This may interfere with normal app usage and change the way that other apps appear.

SYSTEM_CAMERA.label: Allow an application or service access to system cameras to take pictures and videos
SYSTEM_CAMERA.description: This privileged or system app can take pictures and record videos using a system camera at any time. Requires the android.permission.CAMERA permission to be held by the app as well

TRANSMIT_IR.label: transmit infrared
TRANSMIT_IR.description: Allows the app to use the phone's infrared transmitter.

TURN_SCREEN_ON.label: turn on the screen
TURN_SCREEN_ON.description: Allows the app to turn on the screen.

UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHOUT_USER_ACTION.label: update app without user action
UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHOUT_USER_ACTION.description: Allows the holder to update the app it previously installed without user action

USE_BIOMETRIC.label: use biometric hardware
USE_BIOMETRIC.description: Allows the app to use biometric hardware for authentication

USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND.label: use data in the background
USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND.description: This app can use data in the background. This may increase data usage.

USE_EXACT_ALARM.label: Schedule alarms or event reminders
USE_EXACT_ALARM.description: This app can schedule actions like alarms and reminders to notify you at a desired time in the future.

USE_FINGERPRINT.label: use fingerprint hardware
USE_FINGERPRINT.description: Allows the app to use fingerprint hardware for authentication

USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT.label: display notifications as full screen activities on a locked device
USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT.description: Allows the app to display notifications as full screen activities on a locked device

USE_LOOPBACK_INTERFACE.label: use loopback interface
USE_LOOPBACK_INTERFACE.description: Allows the app to interact with other apps over loopback interface

USE_SIP.label: make/receive SIP calls
USE_SIP.description: Allows the app to make and receive SIP calls.

UWB_RANGING.label: determine relative position between nearby Ultra-Wideband devices
UWB_RANGING.description: Allow the app to determine relative position between nearby Ultra-Wideband devices

VIBRATE.label: control vibration
VIBRATE.description: Allows the app to control the vibrator.

WAKE_LOCK.label: prevent phone from sleeping
WAKE_LOCK.description: Allows the app to prevent the phone from going to sleep.

WARM_UP_CAMERA.label: Allow an application or service to send a warm up signal to the camera sub-system
WARM_UP_CAMERA.description: This privileged or system app can send a signal to the camera sub system in order to warm up a camera device to help with performance amongst other benefits

WRITE_CALENDAR.label: add or modify calendar events and send email to guests without owners' knowledge
WRITE_CALENDAR.description: This app can add, remove, or change calendar events on your phone. This app can send messages that may appear to come from calendar owners, or change events without notifying their owners.

WRITE_CALL_LOG.label: write call log
WRITE_CALL_LOG.description: Allows the app to modify your phone's call log, including data about incoming and outgoing calls. Malicious apps may use this to erase or modify your call log.

WRITE_CONTACTS.label: modify your contacts
WRITE_CONTACTS.description: Allows the app to modify the data about your contacts stored on your phone. This permission allows apps to delete contact data.

WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.label: modify or delete the contents of your shared storage
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.description: Allows the app to write the contents of your shared storage.

WRITE_SETTINGS.label: modify system settings
WRITE_SETTINGS.description: Allows the app to modify the system's settings data. Malicious apps may corrupt your system's configuration.

WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS.label: toggle sync on and off
WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS.description: Allows an app to modify the sync settings for an account. For example, this can be used to enable sync of the People app with an account.

WRITE_VERIFICATION_STATE_E2EE_CONTACT_KE.label: update the verification states of E2EE contact keys owned by other apps
WRITE_VERIFICATION_STATE_E2EE_CONTACT_KE.description: Allows the app to update the verification states of E2EE contact keys owned by other apps
